data.title: Temple Of Faitiche
data.description: Faitiche's bimonthly radio show on LYL: Canadian musician and faitiche artist Daniel Majer with a full hour called "Friends and Fragments". In his own words: For the most part, unreleased works by friends from Vancouver and Berlin, including a couple of upcoming projects by one Jonathan Scherk, but as well a few figures I never met drop in such as the Beach Boys and Ennio Morricone, all interpolated by field recordings I made around Berlin.

show.title: Temple Of Faitiche
show.description: One hour monthly with Faitiche label founder and producer Jan Jelinek (and Groupshow artists), cruising through various repertoires: from anthropological material to contemporary experimental and different electronic movements.
